newsitem.title: UK: Thailand roadshows for Yankee bond next wk - Lehman.
newsitem.headline: Thailand roadshows for Yankee bond next wk - Lehman.

text.p: The Kingdom of Thailand sets off on a roadshow for its Yankee bond next week, syndicate manager at Lehman Brothers said on Thursday.
The deal is expected to be for a minimum of $500 million.
"The deal could well be a two-tranche transaction, possibly one with a 10-year maturity and the other not yet set," he said.
The roadshow will hit Chicago on April 7, Boston on April 8, New York on April 9 and launch is expected on April 10.
Solomon Brothers is joint lead manager for the transaction.
In mid-February Moody's Investors Service said it may cut Thailand's A2 long-term ratings. Standard & Poor's Corp said it had no plans to downgrade Thailand from A.
